    a = max(0.0, f["depth_approach_rate"])

This targeted change transfers 0.02 weight from nearness to path intrusion while preserving the successful motion and reliability terms. Nearness alone can elevate visually close objects outside the forward corridor; emphasizing intrusion should better distinguish genuine conflicts from close but irrelevant objects. That can improve ranking and classification while potentially reducing both false blocks and safety-critical false clears. The centered consistency/quality correction remains deliberately small, so unreliable corroboration cannot dominate strong direct cues. Complexity and runtime remain essentially unchanged.
